subject: mathematics
concept: Constructing and interpreting scatter plots to investigate patterns between two variables
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS-adjacent statistical reasoning principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student plots physical data points for two related measurements and observes the resulting pattern
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a scatter plot pattern to the type of relationship it shows (positive, negative, none)
exercise.abstract: Student constructs a scatter plot from a given data set and describes the pattern observed

misconception_flags: misplots a data point by swapping the x and y values

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
